name: Zobique Career AI
oneLiner: Career guidance, job matching and resume tools for students and early-career professionals.
audience: Students, graduates and early-career professionals, plus the universities and placement cells that support them.
problem: Students lack a clear way to turn their skills into job-ready outcomes and relevant applications.

capabilityDetails.title: Job matching
capabilityDetails.detail: Ranks openings against your profile, skills and preferences.

capabilityDetails.title: Resume builder
capabilityDetails.detail: Builds an ATS-friendly resume from your details in minutes.

capabilityDetails.title: ATS checker
capabilityDetails.detail: Checks a resume against applicant tracking systems before you send it.

capabilityDetails.title: Interview prep
capabilityDetails.detail: Practice for the role you want, with feedback on your answers.

capabilityDetails.title: Career roadmap
capabilityDetails.detail: Lays out the skills and steps toward a target role.

capabilityDetails.title: Placement intelligence
capabilityDetails.detail: Helps universities and placement cells see student readiness.
